Harmonic Drive Mechanism

Mechanical design and development of a harmonic drive transmission for robotic applications.

Project overview

This project focuses on the mechanical design and development of a harmonic drive mechanism for robotic applications. The work involves understanding the transmission architecture and its mechanical components.

Engineering activities

  • Study of the harmonic drive operating principle and its main components.
  • Mechanical design and integration considerations for a robotic system.
  • Evaluation of the mechanism as a compact transmission solution.
